verdict.rationale: Penpot's AI story is an MCP server and plugin API that let external AI agents and LLMs work on design files. It also has a community plugin marketplace that includes AI tools. None of this is built-in, in-editor AI for image generation, background removal, content-aware fill or copy suggestions; these are developer building blocks and third-party extensions, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor
